y-m-37-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esathola isimo sokuba nezimpande zangempela
y-m-37-01.topic: Isimo sezimpande zangempela zesibalo esinenhlamvu ku-coefficient: ingcabango yokuthi kuyisibalo se-quadratic
y-m-37-01.goal: Yazi ukuthi esibalweni esinenhlamvu ku-coefficient, uhlobo lwesisho lungashintsha kuye ngenani lenhlamvu, bese ulungisa ibanga lesiphetho ukuze lifanele isimo emusho wenkinga.
y-m-37-01.material: UMinjae uxazulule le nkinga elandelayo. "Thola ibanga lamanani ka-k lapho isibalo se-quadratic kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (k iyinombolo yangempela) sinezimpande zangempela." (Indlela yokuyifunda: k times x squared, minus 4x, plus 1 equals 0.) Impande yangempela iyimpande eyinombolo yangempela. Bheka isixazululo sikaMinjae umugqa ngomugqa.
y-m-37-01.thinking.1: Nquma ukuthi impendulo ishintsha kanjani lapho isimo senkinga sishintsha
y-m-37-01.thinking.2: Thola futhi uhlole izimo zomngcele wena
y-m-37-01.prereq.0: I-H3 yalo msebenzi iwukwehlukaniswa kobunzima kuphela esigabeni sokukhiqiza; ayisho ukuthi lokhu okuqukethwe kunikezwa noma yiliphi ibanga. Cabanga umfundi osevele wafunda okuqukethwe okungezansi.
y-m-37-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic nenani lezimpande zangempela
y-m-37-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa owenza isiphetho sikaMinjae sibe nzima ukusithemba njengoba sinjalo. Phinda ufunde umusho wenkinga bese uhlola umugqa owodwa ngesikhathi.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thola amagama emushweni wokuqala wenkinga ayisho uhlobo lwesibalo, bese uhlola ukuthi wonke amanani ka-k ahlangabezana naleso simo asekhonjiswe esiphethweni yini.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha inombolo ephelele elula kakhulu phakathi kwamanani ka-k afakiwe esiphethweni, ilifake esishweni, bese usho ukuthi siwuhlobo luni lwesisho.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuze isibalo se-quadratic kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 sibe nezimpande zangempela, i-discriminant kumele yanelise D ≥ 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.explain: Inkinga ithe kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 "isibalo se-quadratic." Ukuze sibe yisibalo se-quadratic, i-coefficient k ye-x² akumele ibe ngu-0. Umugqa 1 waqala ukusebenzisa i-discriminant ngaphandle kokuhlola lesi simo, futhi isiphetho k ≤ 4 emugqeni 4 sihlanganisa k = 0. Ukubala emigqeni 2 no-3 kulungile. Impendulo elungile ngu-k ≤ 4 no-k ≠ 0. Noma ukhethe umugqa 1 noma umugqa 4, iphuzu eliyisihluthulelo livela endaweni efanayo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.prompt: Uma amagama athi "isibalo se-quadratic" ayeshiywe ngaphandle enkingeni futhi yabuza "ibanga lika-k lapho isibalo kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 sinezimpande zangempela," impendulo bekuzoba yini?
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.0: Faka k = 0 no-k = 4 esishweni bese uthola izixazululo wena.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.1: Phawula ukuthi ukhetho ngalunye luvumela k = 0 noma cha, bese uqhathanisa nezixazululo ozithole wena.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.a: k < 4. Uma i-discriminant ingu-0, kunempande ephindwe kabili, ngakho ayifakiwe.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.a: Uma D = 0, kunempande eyodwa yangempela, impande ephindwe kabili. "Inempande yangempela" ihlanganisa nempande ephindwe kabili.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.b: k ≤ 4 no-k ≠ 0. Uma k = 0, akuyona isisho se-quadratic, ngakho akukho sixazululo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.b: Uma k = 0, iba ngu-−4x + 1 = 0 futhi kunempande yangempela x = 1/4. Ukungabi yisisho se-quadratic akusho ukuthi akukho sixazululo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.d: k ≥ 4. Khetha uhlangothi lapho i-discriminant ingu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.d: Hlola futhi isiqondiso sophawu lokungalingani uma uxazulula u-D = 16 − 4k ≥ 0 ku-k. Isibonelo, faka k = 0 no-k = 5 bese uqhathanisa ukuthi likhona yini impande yangempela ngempela.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.explain: Uma isho kuphela "isibalo," k = 0 nayo iyinani elivunyelwe. Uma k = 0, khona-ke −4x + 1 = 0 futhi kukhona impande yangempela u-x = 1/4, ngakho ububanzi bika-k bungu-k ≤ 4 (kufaka no-0). Ngisho nangesixazululo esifanayo, isiphetho singahluka kuye ngombandela ositatimendeni senkinga (ukuthi siyisibalo se-quadratic noma cha).
y-m-37-01.s.s3.prompt: Thola amanani amabili ahlukene ka-k lapho isibalo kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (kulokhu akudingeki sibe yisibalo se-quadratic) sinempande eyodwa yangempela ehlukile ngqo.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala umbandela wokuba nempande eyodwa yangempela ngqo uma i-coefficient ye-x² ingeyona u-0.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala isisho ngesimo lapho i-coefficient ye-x² ingu-0 bese ubala ukuthi sinezixazululo ezingaki.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Kule k, isibalo sinempande eyodwa yangempela ngqo.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Kule k, bala ukuthi isibalo sinezimpande zangempela ezihlukile ezingaki. Bala ngokuhlukanisa ngokuthi i-coefficient ye-x² ingu-0 noma cha.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.explain: Uma k = 4, khona-ke 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)², ngakho kukhona u-x = 1/2 kuphela, futhi uma k = 0, khona-ke −4x + 1 = 0, ngakho kukhona u-x = 1/4 kuphela. U-k = 4 lapho i-discriminant ingu-0 akwanele kuwodwa; kumele ubheke ngokwehlukana no-k = 0, lapho uhlobo lwesisho lushintsha.

y-m-37-07.title: Izixazululo uSua azithole zonke?
y-m-37-07.topic: Ububanzi lapho ukhetha khona abantu abangaba nguwo lapho uthola izixazululo zesibalo se-cubic, nesisekelo sesiphetho
y-m-37-07.goal: Wazi ukuthi isibalo se-cubic esinama-coefficient aphelele singaba nezixazululo ezingezona izinombolo eziphelele, futhi uchaze ngokufanele kumngani ukuthi kungani inani lezixazululo owazithola lodwa lingakuvumeli ukusho u-"ngizithole zonke."
y-m-37-07.material: USua waxazulula inkinga yokuthola zonke izixazululo ezingempela zesibalo se-cubic u-2x³ − x² − 7x + 6 = 0 (Indlela yokufunda: 2 x cubed minus x squared minus 7 x plus 6 equals 0) kanje.

y-m-37-07.prereq.2: Ukubhala isisho se-cubic njengomkhiqizo wesisho somugqa nesisho se-quadratic
y-m-37-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa esixazululweni sikaSua onzima ukuwethemba. Hlola ngokuhlukile ukuthi ukubala emgqeni ngamunye kulungile yini nokuthi ingqondo ilungile yini.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda wenze ukubala kokufaka emigqeni 2 no-3 wena futhi uhlole ukuthi amanani alungile yini.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.1: Emgqeni 4, sebenza ukuthi u-"ubuningi obungu-3" no-"lezi ezimbili kuphela" kusho into efanayo yini. Isibonelo, ku-(x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3) = 0, kwenzekani uma uthola izixazululo ezimbili kuphela bese uyeka?
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.0: Uma kukhona izixazululo, ziphakathi kwezihlukanisi zegama eliqhubekayo u-6, ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6, ngakho sihlola kuphela lezi ezingu-8.

y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.2: Abantu abasele abangaba nguwo ±3, ±6, 2, −1 bonke abangu-0 uma befakwa.

Uma i-coefficient eholayo ingu-2, isixazululo sengxenyana njengo-3/2 siyenzeka nasso. Umugqa 4: u-"ubuningi obungu-3" usho ukuthi kungaba ngu-3 ubuningi, ngakho ukuthola ezingu-2 akusona isizathu sokusho ukuthi azikho ezinye. Ukubala emigqeni 2 no-3 kulungile.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.prompt: Thola isixazululo sesithathu esingempela uSua asiphuthele futhi usifake njenge-decimal. (Sibhale njenge-decimal, njengo-0.5, isibonelo.)
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi yisiphi isithiyo iqiniso lokuthi izixazululo u-x = 1 no-x = −2 ziyaziwa elibeka ngalo emfanekisweni wesisho se-cubic.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala lesi sithiyo, uthole ukuthi yisiphi isisho esilula esisele, bese ufaka u-x owenza lesi sisho sibe ngu-0 esibalweni sokuqala ukuhlola.

y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Faka inani owalifake esishweni futhi ubale wena ukuthi liba ngu-0 yini.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Udinga ukuthola inani elingesilo elinye lezixazululo uSua asevele ezithole (u-1 no-−2).
y-m-37-07.s.s2.explain: Uma ufaka u-x = 3/2 = 1.5, bese u-2·(27/8) − 9/4 − 21/2 + 6 = 0. Isibalo singabhalwa njengo-(x − 1)(x + 2)(2x − 3) = 0, ngakho kunezixazululo ezintathu, u-1, −2, 3/2. U-3/2 akayena isihlukanisi sika-6.

Uma ufaka u-x = 3/2, bese u-2·27/8 − 9/4 − 21/2 + 6 = 0. Ngesikhathi esilandelayo, hlola ukuthi ukhawulele abantu abangaba nguwo ezinombolweni eziphelele kuphela yini.

y-m-37-05.title: Ukubheka isitatimende esithi "uma igrafu ayihlangani ne-x-axis, ihlala igcina"
y-m-37-05.topic: Umbandela wokuthi ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kuhlale kugcina: i-discriminant ne-coefficient yokuqala
y-m-37-05.goal: Khombisa ngezibonelo eziphikisayo ukuthi ukuze ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kugcine kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela umbandela we-discriminant kuphela awanele futhi uphawu lwe-coefficient yokuqala nalo luyadingeka, bese usho ukuthi umngcele (D = 0) usho ini.
y-m-37-05.material: USoyoung ufinyeze kanje: "Ekungalinganini kwe-quadratic ax² + bx + c > 0 (a ≠ 0, a, b, c kuyizinombolo zangempela), uma i-discriminant D = b² − 4ac incane kuno-0, lokhu kungalingani kugcina kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x." (Indlela yokufunda: a x squared kanye no-b x kanye no-c kukhulu kuno-0.)

y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.a: Kuhlala kulungile njengoba kunjalo. Uma D < 0, i-parabola ayihlangani ne-x-axis.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.a: Kulungile ukuthi i-parabola ayihlangani ne-x-axis, kodwa ukuthi i-parabola iphezulu noma iphansi kwe-x-axis kuyindaba ehlukile.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.b: Uma u-D < 0, akusebenzi kunoma yimuphi u-x.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.b: Cabanga ngesibonelo esinou-a > 0, u-x² + 1 > 0. U-D = −4, nokho kusebenza kuwo wonke ama-x.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.c: Awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi kulungile uze ufake izinombolo ku-a, b, c.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukufaka izinombolo nakho kuyindlela enhle, kodwa uma ucabanga ngomumo we-parabola, ungahlulela ngaphandle kwezinombolo.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.d: Uma u-a enegethivu, akusebenzi, ngakho kuphosile njengoba kunjalo.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.explain: Uma u-D < 0, i-parabola u-y = ax² + bx + c ayihlangani ne-x-axis. Kodwa uma u-a < 0, i-parabola ingaphansi kwe-x-axis kuphela, ngakho ukungalingani akusebenzi kunoma yimuphi u-x. Isibonelo, u-−x² − 1 > 0 awunaye u-x lapho usebenza khona (u-D = −4 < 0).
y-m-37-05.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amathiriphu amabili ezinombolo eziphelele (a, b, c) ezinhlobo ezihlukile lapho i-discriminant u-D = b² − 4ac ingu-0 noma ingaphansi, nokho u-ax² + bx + c > 0 akusebenzi kuzo zonke izinombolo ezingempela u-x. Izinhlobo: ziyizinhlobo ezihlukile uma uphawu luka-a luhlukile, noma uma ukuthi u-D ungu-0 noma cha kuhlukile.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi umumo we-parabola uhluka kanjani uma u-a ephozithivu nalapho u-a enegethivu, nokuthi ihlangana ne-x-axis emaphoyintini amangaki uma u-D engu-0.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kuma-(a, b, c) owakhethile, faka amanani amaningana ku-x futhi uthole u-x oyedwa lapho ukungalingani kungasebenzi, ukuhlola.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.ok.c1: U-a uyinombolo ephelele engesiyo u-0, futhi u-b no-c nabo bayizinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c1: U-a kumele abe yinombolo ephelele engesiyo u-0, futhi u-b no-c nabo kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele.

U-(1, 2, 1) unika u-x² + 2x + 1 = (x + 1)² > 0, oba ngu-0 ku-x = −1, ngakho akusebenzi (u-D = 0, a > 0). U-(−1, 2, −1) unika u-−(x − 1)² > 0, ongasebenzi kunoma yimuphi u-x (u-D = 0, a < 0). y-m-37-08.goal: Wazi ukuthi uma inani lezixazululo eziphelele zohlelo lokungalingani lilungisiwe, ipharamitha ingaba namanani amaningana, futhi uhlulele ngokuhlola ngqo ukuthi inani lomkhawulo lifakiwe yini.
y-m-37-08.material: Cabanga ngohlelo lokungalingani { x² − x − 6 < 0, x > a } (u-a uyinombolo engempela). Isixazululo sokungalingani kokuqala singu-−2 < x < 3. y-m-37-08.s.s1.prompt: Uma u-a = 0, zingaki izinombolo eziphelele u-x ezanelisa kokubili ukungalingani?

y-m-37-02.title: Uma impande eyodwa ingu-1+2i, enye impande iyini?
y-m-37-02.topic: Izimpande eziyinkimbinkimbi nemibandela yama-coefficient: umcabango lapho ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient bugcina khona
y-m-37-02.goal: Yazi ukuthi ukusho "enye impande iyinombolo eyinkimbinkimbi ye-conjugate" kusibalo se-quadratic esinikezwe impande eyinkimbinkimbi, udinga umbandela wama-coefficient, bese wakha wena ezinye izindlela ezingenzeka uma umbandela ulahlekile.
y-m-37-02.material: Impande eyodwa yesibalo se-quadratic x² + px + q = 0 ngu-1 + 2i. (i iyiyunithi engokwengqondo ene-i² = −1. Indlela yokufunda: x squared kanye no-p x kanye no-q kulingana no-0.) UHyunjun uthe, "Khona-ke enye impande ngu-1 − 2i, ngakho singathola p no-q."

y-m-37-02.thinking.2: Yakha isibonelo esiphikisayo uma umbandela ulahlekile

y-m-37-02.prereq.2: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient esibalo se-quadratic (isamba nomphumela wezimpande ezimbili)
y-m-37-02.s.s1.prompt: Njengoba uHyunjun esho, ukuthola p no-q udinga ulwazi olwengeziwe olungekho esitatimendeni. Khetha konke kulokhu okulandelayo lapho ukwengeza ucezu olulodwa nje lolwazi kumisa p no-q ngakunye libe yinani elilodwa.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, biza enye impande ngokuthi r, bese ubhala imibandela okumele u-1 + 2i no-r bahlangabezane nayo.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ungenza r ezimbili ezihlukile ezihlangabezana nokukhetha ngakunye yini. Uma ungenza ezimbili, lolo lwazi lodwa alwanele.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.a: Inqobo nje uma p iyinombolo ephelele, amanani amaningi ayenzeka, njengo-p = 0, p = 1, njalo njalo. Isibonelo, uma p = 0, enye impande ngu-−1 − 2i, ehlukile esimeni lapho p = −2.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.b: Uma iyimpande ephindwe kabili, zombili izimpande zimiswa njengo-1 + 2i, ngakho p no-q nabo bamiswa. Akunandaba ukuthi ama-coefficient aba izinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.c: Uma p no-q zingezangempela, enye impande iyinombolo eyinkimbinkimbi ye-conjugate ukuze izingxenye eziphoqayo ziphikisane, futhi p no-q bamiswa.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukwazi kuphela ukuthi q yangempela akumisi enye impande. Isibonelo, uma enye impande ingu-2 − 4i, khona-ke q = 10 yangempela, kodwa p = −3 + 2i ayiyona yangempela.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.explain: Uma p no-q kokubili kungezangempela, enye impande imiswa njengo-1 − 2i, futhi p = −2, q = 5. Uma iyimpande ephindwe kabili, zombili izimpande zingu-1 + 2i, ngakho p = −2 − 4i no-q = −3 + 4i bamiswa, kodwa ama-coefficient awawona angempela. y-m-37-06.topic: Ukubuyisela ama-coefficient kusuka esixazululweni sokungalingani kwe-quadratic: ulwazi lwanele?
y-m-37-06.goal: Bonisa ngezibonelo eziningana ukuthi isikhawu sesixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic sodwa asilungisi ama-coefficient abe impendulo eyodwa futhi silungisa kuphela uphawu luka-a, futhi ukhethe ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ngempela ukulungisa ama-coefficient abe impendulo eyodwa.
y-m-37-06.material: Isixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic u-ax² + bx + c > 0 singu-−1 < x < 3. Lokhu kusho ukuthi isixazululo yizo zonke izinombolo ezingempela eziphakathi kuka-−1 no-3. (U-a, b, c yizinombolo eziphelele futhi u-a ≠ 0. Indlela yokufunda: a x squared plus b x plus c is greater than 0.)
y-m-37-06.thinking.0: Hlulela ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe lwanele isiphetho yini
y-m-37-06.thinking.2: Khomba ukuthi ulwazi olusha luphindaphinda ulwazi osuvele unalo yini
y-m-37-06.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwesixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic negrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic
y-m-37-06.prereq.2: Ukuhlola izimpande zesibalo se-quadratic ngezici noma ngokufaka
y-m-37-06.s.s1.prompt: Inani luka-a, b, c lilungisiwe libe yimpendulo eyodwa ngalolu lwazi kuphela?
y-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yakha ukungalingani kwe-quadratic okubili okuhlukile isixazululo sako singu-−1 < x < 3 wena futhi uziqhathanise.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi inani luka-ax² + bx + c kumele libe yini ku-x = −1 no-x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.a: Kulungisiwe. Iziphetho ezimbili zesixazululo ngu-−1 no-3, ngakho isisho singu-x² − 2x − 3 > 0 nje.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.a: Isixazululo sika-x² − 2x − 3 > 0 singu-x < −1 noma u-x > 3. Kufanele uhlukanise icala lapho isixazululo siphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili nelicala lapho singaphandle.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.b: Kulungisiwe. Ukubeka u-a = 1 kuyindlela ejwayelekile, ngakho kukhona eyodwa kuphela.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.b: U-a = 1 yinani owalikhetha ngokungafanele. Inkinga ayinalo ulwazi lokuthi u-a = 1, futhi futhi ayihambisani nesimo sokuthi isixazululo siphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.c: Akulungisiwe. Asikwazi ngisho ukusho uphawu luka-a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Iqiniso lokuthi isixazululo siphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili lisho ukuthi i-parabola inomumo ∩ (ivulekela phansi), ngakho ungasho uphawu luka-a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.d: Akulungisiwe. U-a < 0, kodwa usayizi unokungenzeka okuningi.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: Izimpande ezimbili zingu-−1 no-3 futhi isixazululo siphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili, ngakho u-a < 0. Linefomu u-a(x + 1)(x − 3) > 0, ngakho u-−x² + 2x + 3 > 0, u-−2x² + 4x + 6 > 0, ... , futhi kunezisho ezingenzeka ngokungenamkhawulo.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Thola amathiriphu amathathu ahlukile ezinombolo eziphelele (a, b, c) enza ukungalingani kwe-quadratic u-ax² + bx + c > 0 onesixazululo u-−1 < x < 3 ngqo.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izibalo ezimbili ku-a, b, c ezenza isisho sibe ngu-0 uma ufaka u-x = −1 no-x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-b, c owabuthola no-a, yenza izibonelo ngokushintsha inani luka-a, futhi uhlole uphawu luka-a.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani oliyithola ngokufaka u-x = −1 ku-ax² + bx + c kumele libe ngu-0. Okwamanje akulona u-0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Inani oliyithola ngokufaka u-x = 3 ku-ax² + bx + c kumele libe ngu-0. Okwamanje akulona u-0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Umumo unjalo ukuthi isixazululo isikhawu esiphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Bheka futhi uphawu luka-a. Ukuze isixazululo sibe yisikhawu esiphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili, i-parabola kumele ibe nomumo muni?
y-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Noma yiliphi ithiriphu lezinombolo eziphelele elinou-b = −2a, c = −3a futhi a < 0, njengo-(−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6), (−3, 6, 9), linesixazululo u-−1 < x < 3. Ziyizisho ezilinganayo, ngakho izixazululo ziyafana.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Uma wengeza elilodwa kulokhu okulandelayo kulwazi lokuthi isixazululo singu-−1 < x < 3, khona-ke u-(a, b, c) ulungiswa abe yimpendulo eyodwa. Yikuphi?
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kuzibonelo ezintathu owazenza ngaphambilini, hlola ukuthi ulwazi lwenketho ngayinye selivele lusebenza kuzo zonke yini.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Uma ulwazi selivele lusebenza kuyo yonke isibonelo, akulona ulwazi olusha. Thola inketho lapho lungenjalo khona.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.a: Uma u-x = 0, inani luka-ax² + bx + c lingu-3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.b: I-axis ye-symmetry yomsebenzi we-quadratic u-y = ax² + bx + c ngu-x = 1.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.b: Uma isixazululo singu-−1 < x < 3, indawo ephakathi yezimpande ezimbili isivele ingu-x = 1. Uphindaphinde ulwazi olwase lufakiwe.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.c: Izimpande ezimbili zesibalo u-ax² + bx + c = 0 zingu-−1 no-3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.c: Uma kungukungalingani onesixazululo u-−1 < x < 3, usungasho ukuthi izimpande zesibalo zingu-−1 no-3. Akulona ulwazi olusha.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.d: U-a, b, c bonke bayizinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.d: Lesi simo sesivele sinikeziwe, futhi kunezisho eziningana ezinama-coefficient aphelele, njengo-(−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6).
y-m-37-06.s.s3.explain: Inani ku-x = 0 ngu-c. Uma u-c = 3, bese kusukela ku-c = −3a sithola u-a = −1, futhi u-b = 2 ulungisiwe. Izinketho ezisele ziyizinto ongase usho kakade kusuka esixazululweni u-−1 < x < 3, ngakho akulona ulwazi olusha. Indlela yokukhomba ukuthi ulwazi lusha yini: hlola ukuthi izisho eziningana ezahlukile ezanelisa lolo lwazi zisalokhu zisele yini.
